summary: Teaches how to create a private network, generate a token, and install and run the PDC agent to connect private data sources.

needs.description: Host (Linux/Docker/K8s) to download and run the PDC agent binary with the generated token; only needed to complete the install steps for real.
Private data source connect available on the stack and user able to create networks/tokens.

reviewNotes: Before you begin is empty. Pure UI steps (Add new network, token) need no external infra; agent steps are instructional.
